precommit.v1_aborted_reason: The first Breast Cancer workload exceeded a 300-second bounded tool window after only 6/24 calibration progress counters. No score/runtime summary was emitted or persisted; those partial measurements were quarantined and not used to choose v2.

forecast_qc.conditional_metric_note: The evaluation regime produced no usable multi-checkpoint unfinished traces for this conditional remaining-time statistic; it is reported undefined rather than fabricated.

precommitted_interpretation.interpretation: Null/easy-regime result: direct candidates usually succeeded before any switch checkpoint or a first evaluation could not fit the deadline. No switching policy improved this workload under the precommitted rule. This is negative evidence against assuming that reforecasting helps every workload, not evidence against reforecasting in overrun regimes.

raw_local_report.note: The durable contract stores aggregate outcomes and exact seed/config precommit. The raw local report was 61,020 bytes and was not used after the semantic-freeze drift check.

second_workload_status.mechanical_observation: A sequential run completed 12/12 calibration episodes but timed out before evaluation summaries; a fold-parallel rerun completed 12/12 calibration and 13/18 evaluation progress counters before timeout. No final score/runtime summary was emitted or persisted, so partial outcomes are not interpreted.
second_workload_status.next_action: Resume or redesign only under the next fresh control tuple; preserve the precommit and do not mine partial outcomes for threshold changes.

scope_limit: One completed real bundled dataset, two model families, one host/runtime. The null result is not generalized to arbitrary optimizers or overrun distributions.
